newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Active Voice cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Active Voice cut.

text.p: -- First Albany said it downgraded Active Voice Corp to neutral from buy.
-- Cut fourth quarter estimate to $0.15 per share from $0.28 based on company's announcement yesterday that quarterly revenues and earnings would fall short of expectations.
-- Company also announced yesterday a product alliance with a Siemens AG unit, a deal it said was worth more than $50 million in software revenues over six years.

-- "While the longer-term implications from yesterday's announcements are extremely positive, given the length of time until the impact is felt and the current market environment, we feel it is prudent to forego investing in Active Voice shares at this time."
